support.title: Support
support.description: Otopoly support: contact details and answers to common questions about sign-up, sign-in, account deletion and privacy.
support.intro: Write to us with questions, bug reports or suggestions about Otopoly. Mention your business name and the screen where the problem happened so we can help faster.
support.contact_hours: We reply to messages on business days.
support.faq_account_q: How do I create an account?
support.faq_account_a: Register your business at otopoly.app/register. The business owner creates staff accounts from inside the app.
support.faq_signin_q: I can't sign in. What should I do?
support.faq_signin_a: Use the password reset step on the sign-in screen. If you are a staff member, ask the business owner to confirm your account is active. If the problem continues, email us.
support.faq_delete_q: How do I delete my account?
support.faq_delete_a: You can request account deletion on the account deletion page.
support.faq_privacy_a: Our privacy policy explains which data we process and why.
